bins.glass: Glass bottle bank / green glass bin
bins.organic: Compost heap or green / organic waste bin
bins.ewaste: E-waste drop-off point or electronics retailer take-back
bins.hazardous: Hazardous waste collection point — never household bins

items.name: plastic bottle
items.handling: Empty it, rinse, squash and put the cap back on.
items.where: Plastics / yellow recycling bin

items.name: plastic bag
items.handling: Reuse it. Many kerbside bins refuse film — return to supermarket film collection if available.
items.where: Plastics / yellow recycling bin

items.name: plastic cup
items.handling: Rinse and recycle with plastics.
items.where: Plastics / yellow recycling bin

items.name: food wrapper
items.handling: Mixed-material film: put in plastics only if accepted locally, otherwise general waste.
items.where: Plastics / yellow recycling bin

items.name: plastic container
items.handling: Scrape out food, rinse, recycle with plastics.
items.where: Plastics / yellow recycling bin

items.name: straw
items.handling: Too small to sort — general waste. Switch to reusable straws.
items.where: Plastics / yellow recycling bin

items.name: plastic cutlery
items.handling: Usually not recyclable — general waste; prefer reusable cutlery.
items.where: Plastics / yellow recycling bin

items.name: jerrycan
items.handling: Rinse well; reuse or recycle with rigid plastics. If it held fuel or chemicals, treat as hazardous.
items.where: Plastics / yellow recycling bin

items.name: shampoo bottle
items.handling: Rinse out and recycle with plastics; remove pumps.
items.where: Plastics / yellow recycling bin

items.name: styrofoam
items.handling: Rarely recycled kerbside — check local drop-off; otherwise general waste.
items.where: Plastics / yellow recycling bin

items.name: cardboard box
items.handling: Flatten, remove tape, keep dry.
items.where: Paper & cardboard / blue recycling bin

items.name: newspaper
items.handling: Keep dry and recycle with paper.
items.where: Paper & cardboard / blue recycling bin

items.name: paper
items.handling: Recycle with paper; shred sensitive documents first.
items.where: Paper & cardboard / blue recycling bin

items.name: book
items.handling: Donate if usable; otherwise recycle with paper (remove hard covers).
items.where: Paper & cardboard / blue recycling bin

items.name: pizza box
items.handling: Greasy parts go to compost; clean lid parts can go with paper.
items.where: Compost heap or green / organic waste bin

items.name: paper cup
items.handling: Most have a plastic lining — use a cup recycling point or general waste. Lids go with plastics.
items.where: Paper & cardboard / blue recycling bin

items.name: egg carton
items.handling: Recycle with paper or compost it.
items.where: Paper & cardboard / blue recycling bin

items.name: tissue
items.handling: Used tissues can be composted; never in paper recycling.
items.where: Compost heap or green / organic waste bin

items.name: milk carton
items.handling: Rinse and flatten; recycle where cartons are accepted.
items.where: Paper & cardboard / blue recycling bin

items.name: glass bottle
items.handling: Rinse, remove caps (caps go to metal), bottle bank.
items.where: Glass bottle bank / green glass bin

items.name: glass jar
items.handling: Rinse, remove the metal lid, recycle with glass.
items.where: Glass bottle bank / green glass bin

items.name: drinking glass
items.handling: Drinking glass and window glass melt differently — wrap and put in general waste unless your area accepts it.
items.where: Glass bottle bank / green glass bin

items.name: mirror
items.handling: Not bottle-bank glass. Wrap safely and take to a recycling centre.
items.where: Glass bottle bank / green glass bin

items.name: aluminium can
items.handling: Empty, rinse and squash.
items.where: Metals & cans recycling bin

items.name: food tin
items.handling: Rinse, push the lid inside, recycle with metals.
items.where: Metals & cans recycling bin

items.name: aluminium foil
items.handling: Clean foil only — scrunch into a ball first.
items.where: Metals & cans recycling bin

items.name: bottle cap
items.handling: Collect caps in a can, then recycle with metals.
items.where: Metals & cans recycling bin

items.name: cutlery
items.handling: Donate if usable, otherwise scrap metal recycling.
items.where: Metals & cans recycling bin

items.name: scrap metal
items.handling: Take to a scrap-metal dealer or recycling centre.
items.where: Metals & cans recycling bin

items.name: aerosol can
items.handling: Only fully empty aerosols go in metal recycling. Partly full ones are hazardous.
items.where: Hazardous waste collection point — never household bins

items.name: banana peel
items.handling: Compost it.
items.where: Compost heap or green / organic waste bin

items.name: fruit
items.handling: Compost it.
items.where: Compost heap or green / organic waste bin

items.name: vegetables
items.handling: Compost it.
items.where: Compost heap or green / organic waste bin

items.name: food scraps
items.handling: Organic bin; meat and bones only if your compost service accepts them.
items.where: Compost heap or green / organic waste bin

items.name: coffee grounds
items.handling: Compost it — great for soil.
items.where: Compost heap or green / organic waste bin

items.name: eggshells
items.handling: Compost it (crush first).
items.where: Compost heap or green / organic waste bin

items.name: garden waste
items.handling: Compost or green waste collection.
items.where: Compost heap or green / organic waste bin

items.name: wood
items.handling: Untreated wood can be composted or chipped; painted wood goes to a recycling centre.
items.where: Compost heap or green / organic waste bin

items.name: phone
items.handling: Wipe data, remove SIM, take to an e-waste collection point.
items.where: E-waste drop-off point or electronics retailer take-back

items.name: laptop
items.handling: Back up and wipe data; e-waste collection or manufacturer take-back.
items.where: E-waste drop-off point or electronics retailer take-back

items.name: charger
items.handling: E-waste drop-off; cables are valuable for copper recovery.
items.where: E-waste drop-off point or electronics retailer take-back

items.name: remote control
items.handling: Remove the batteries (hazardous), then e-waste.
items.where: E-waste drop-off point or electronics retailer take-back

items.name: television
items.handling: E-waste collection — old CRT screens contain lead.
items.where: E-waste drop-off point or electronics retailer take-back

items.name: keyboard
items.handling: E-waste drop-off point.
items.where: E-waste drop-off point or electronics retailer take-back

items.name: small appliance
items.handling: E-waste or electrical recycling point.
items.where: E-waste drop-off point or electronics retailer take-back

items.name: battery
items.handling: Tape the terminals and take to a battery collection point. Never bin — fire risk.
items.where: Hazardous waste collection point — never household bins

items.name: light bulb
items.handling: Contains mercury — hazardous collection. LED bulbs go to e-waste.
items.where: Hazardous waste collection point — never household bins

items.name: paint
items.handling: Hazardous waste collection; never pour down drains.
items.where: Hazardous waste collection point — never household bins

items.name: chemicals
items.handling: Keep in the original container, lid tight; hazardous collection.
items.where: Hazardous waste collection point — never household bins

items.name: medicine
items.handling: Return to a pharmacy or health centre for safe disposal.
items.where: Pharmacy / health-centre take-back

items.name: syringe
items.handling: Put in a rigid sharps container and return to a health facility.
items.where: Hazardous waste collection point — never household bins

items.name: motor oil
items.handling: Seal in a container and take to a garage or hazardous collection.
items.where: Hazardous waste collection point — never household bins

items.name: thermometer
items.handling: Mercury — hazardous collection. Digital thermometers are e-waste.
items.where: Hazardous waste collection point — never household bins

items.name: gas cylinder
items.handling: Return to the supplier; never crush or burn.
items.where: Hazardous waste collection point — never household bins

items.name: nail polish
items.handling: Hazardous collection.
items.where: Hazardous waste collection point — never household bins

items.name: diaper
items.handling: Not recyclable — wrap and put in general waste (not compost).
items.where: General waste bin (wrapped)
